posts.content_html_raw:
Although I discovered this game some time ago, I haven't visited this thread much because I wasn't sure what to say. This game is definitely something else. Possibly both the best and the worst emotional rollercoaster that I've been on. I like how varied the characters are and that it doesn't shy away from heavier topics. Despite the fact that I should expect these moments by now, most of them still take me by surprise.
About this recent update
I expected something to happen but... Sana and Rin have been my favorites from the start so this was just awful. I wasn't surprised being caught with Ayane, but I thought it will be by someone else and with a slightly better outcome. With Rin however, I'm not even sure what to make of this. In any other game I'd expect a happy threesome ending eventually but not in this one.
And about the aftermath
Although this update included so many good but often sad scenes, my personal favorite is probably still the introduction of Chinami, so that bit with her and Yumi, don't you dare...
All in all, thank you for this wonderful game.
Edit- I forgot a minor suggestion, to keep completed lust events in pink.

So I started playing this game and got a few questions:
1. On a scale of 1 to 10 where 1 is „creepy dialogue“ and 10 is detailed decapitation, how much horror do I have to expect?

2. Since there is no proper walkthrough: Are any scenes missable

3. As I am all for wholesome and consenting fun, how rapey does it get? Asking this because of that scene where the MC forcefully kisses the delinquent girl (forgive me, I haven‘t memorized all their names yet). That was a bit much for me. Probably because I like her, but also because I don‘t know where I need to expect the horror.

4. Will I get hit with a big Sad anytime in the future? Like „Acting Lessons sad“? I don‘t think I can endure something like that a second time.
It‘s a great game so far. I really enjoy the writing and was quite happy to learn that there are not only school girls but also others (like Sanas mother). Big plus and I hope there is some content with them, too.

Missed scenes are crossed out like this if you missed them. Multiple saves are a good idea, but it isn't really hard to get all the scenes.

As Raf-Raf posted earlier, this is some of the dialogue from the most recent event. Pretty good indicator what kind of MC we're dealing with here.

5. There is content with Sara (Sana's mom) and Haruka (Rin's boss) already. Likely to be more in the future.

I'm assuming there's a specific order to which you are adding the scenes (still on .7 so I don't know anything about the beach trip content), but I'm a little concerned that you're adding and seem to plan to add so many characters when so many characters who have been around forever are barely past their introductory events (Sana and Miku spring immediately to mind). Certainly it feels like the game's expanding but it doesn't really seem to be getting deeper. On the other hand, Tsuneyo and Molly are both well written characters and the secret events make me feel personally attacked (in a good way), so you're definitely still accomplishing what I'm assuming you set out to, I'd just like to see more of the original cast get some well overdue development before even more girls are introduced.

Unless you have a highly specific plan in regards to the way the story is unveiled, in which case carry on. I certainly trust you as a writer, I've just also seen too many great projects overwhelmed by feature creep.

Rin's heartbreak was so intense...so true. But i am sure this will allow some good evolution with MC for both characters ! I can't wait to see what's next.
spoilers.text:
Overall i liked this 0.8.0 a lot, all the "Rin and Chika" thing going a lot further, same for Ayane and Kirin, even the little Yumi goodbye thing haha

I'm interested to see where this game goes from here. I see a lot of potential with it, but that's just cause I like the characters and settings. Wouldn't mind something like this, with animated scenes, but less...glitches. Anyone know of anything, point me in that direction.

posts.content_html_raw:
I really do not like locked or exclusive content - this is a harem. Can we please avoid it? We are all here to see all the scenes and enjoy them. I hate having to follow guides or use multiple saves and it's one of the reasons why I enjoy LiL more than any other game on here. Rin being locked simply because we pursued Chika before the beach trip doesn't feel good. I now have that event crossed off staring me in the face (and likely more in the future?). It'd be different if it was really obvious and easy to rollback a choice and change it, but at this point I'd have to start a whole new save since I pursued Chika many versions ago. That's dozen of hours of work at this point.

I'd love to see a patreon poll to change this event and see if other patreon subscribers are also strongly against locked/exclusive content in future releases. This is exactly what I want, that’s the thing. I thrive off of that uncertainty about whether or not an action will ruin things in the future and vice versa. This game was always built around that, but it wasn’t until now that it started coming into play. Things aren’t open-ended and confusing unintentionally. I want you to be worried and I want the consequences to feel real when they come. That’s why I don’t want to give too much away about which choices are “Wrong” or “Right.” I want them to fester and linger in your head until you find out on your own.

I’m a completionist just like many of you. Hell, I can’t even move onto another VN until I 100% the CG gallery, so there will always be a way to get everything in one playthrough. It just won’t be clear how until a long time from now. Game is nowhere near complete yet.

Thank you so much for playing and I hope you enjoy your journey even during the times that I make it hard or frustrating.

Life is hard and frustrating too.
This is a new life.

This is exactly what I want, that’s the thing. I thrive off of that uncertainty about whether or not an action will ruin things in the future and vice versa. This game was always built around that, but it wasn’t until now that it started coming into play. Things aren’t open-ended and confusing unintentionally. I want you to be worried and I want the consequences to feel real when they come. That’s why I don’t want to give too much away about which choices are “Wrong” or “Right.” I want them to fester and linger in your head until you find out on your own.
I’m a completionist just like many of you. Hell, I can’t even move onto another VN until I 100% the CG gallery, so there will always be a way to get everything in one playthrough. It just won’t be clear how until a long time from now. Game is nowhere near complete yet.
Thank you so much for playing and I hope you enjoy your journey even during the times that I make it hard or frustrating.
Life is hard and frustrating too.
This is a new life.

I am towards the end of the current content, and I have to say, so far I am really enjoying the game so far! I do have one complaint I am noticing... In the begining, the MC treats every character differently depending on their personality, whcih is a good thing as it brings in some variety.

However, as things get more intimate, that changes drastically.

I paused to type this while in the middle of Futaba's last event. At first she was this shy girl who the MC wants to help build her confidence. Yet, for the handjob scene, he was weirdly forceful, yet she accepted it and made it fine. She even enjoyed it, and he gets more forceful for each scene.

The same happens with Makoto, and while I have yet to reach such a state, it feels as if Chika is heading that way too. It feels like the unique part of the intereactions I mentioned before is disapearing. Sure the girls retain their previous personalities, and it makes sense that the relationships evolve, however I worry that all the girls will inevitably be carbon copies of each other with some flavor text differences as the story progresses.

It will be a shame if more girls get this treatment. I'm pretty confident that they will. While Makoto was only somewhere in the middle rankings for me in the best girl status, she has easily fallen towards the bottom. Meanwhile Futaba was one of the top early on, yet it also seems she is down grading as well.

As for Ayame, she is odd for other reasons. She is shown to be the submissive type early on but seems to get the oposite treatment. Where Makoto and Futaba where never shown to have a sub fetish, they get treated as if they do, while Ayame who does, aside from a handful of scenes does not get treated as sub, instead as a yandere type. Giving here a uniqu approach compared to the other two. Yet, because of the unique was she has been handled, she has somehow risen in that same ranking, from low mid to high mid.

Also, I like Chika, but if you continue feeding me those adorable Chiname scenes, give Chika the same treatment as Makoto and Futaba. Just let me take care of Chiname. She's adorable. Easily the best girl, with or without sexual content.

However, as things get more intimate, that changes drastically.

I paused to type this while in the middle of Futaba's last event. At first she was this shy girl who the MC wants to help build her confidence. Yet, for the handjob scene, he was weirdly forceful, yet she accepted it and made it fine. She even enjoyed it, and he gets more forceful for each scene.

The same happens with Makoto, and while I have yet to reach such a state, it feels as if Chika is heading that way too.
